captions.detailed: This 3D model is a parametric paintbrush holder designed to keep multiple brushes organized. It features a series of repeating V-shaped slots along its top edge, supported by a solid base. The overall geometry is defined by a rectangular block that has been sculpted with triangular prisms and angled cutouts to form the brush rests.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric paintbrush holder in OpenSCAD with adjustable parameters for the number of brush slots, holder width, slot spacing, holder height, profile thickness, base height, and the slope of the brush supports. The design should feature a series of repeating V-shaped supports on a flat base.
captions.factory: The script constructs the paintbrush holder using a combination of custom polyhedrons and cubes. A union of a loop-generated series of triangular polyhedrons (representing the spikes) and a rectangular base cube forms the solid shape. A second, shifted set of polyhedrons and cubes is then subtracted using the difference() operator to hollow out the bottom portion, leaving a uniform profile thickness.
